title: oxalis petersianum
intro: Oxalis petersianum, commonly known as the Mexican wood-sorrel, is a plant species belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents present in Oxalis petersianum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis petersianum are also attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, providing relaxation and calming effects.
